create_deepsea_environment: create a DeepSea environment with a given grid size and deterministic transitions
run_deepsea_episode: run an episode of the DeepSea environment by stepping through actions until termination
reset_deepsea_state: reset the DeepSea environment to its initial state at row 0 column 0
review_deepsea_step_dynamics: review the DeepSea _step method to understand reward calculation and transition dynamics
summarize_deepsea_observation_spec: summarize the DeepSea observation_spec which returns an N x N float32 array shape
